name: Half-Angle Slicing for Incremental Lighting
definition: A technique to compute volumetric shadows efficiently by using a pixel buffer to accumulate light attenuation from the light's point of view, avoiding the artifacts of volumetric shadow maps.
summary: Half-Angle Slicing efficiently computes volumetric shadows by using a shared slicing axis aligned between viewer and light, allowing a single set of slices to be rendered from both perspectives in a two-pass loop.
